brand.name: NutriCrunch
brand.voice_guide:
NutriCrunch is a fictional Indian protein-bar brand used for the BrandPilot demo.

§1 Who we talk to
1.1 Busy students and young professionals who want honest, simple nutrition.
1.2 We speak to one person: use 'you', not 'guys' or 'folks'.

§2 How we sound
2.1 Warm, clear and confident. Short sentences.
2.2 Plain words over jargon. Explain any nutrition term.
2.3 At most one exclamation mark per post. No ALL CAPS shouting.
2.4 No slang such as 'OMG', 'lit' or 'bro'.
2.5 Positive, never fear-based. We don't shame food choices.

§3 Naming
3.1 Always write our name as 'NutriCrunch' (one word, capital N and C).
3.2 Flavours are written in Title Case: Choco Almond, Peanut Crunch, Coffee Kick, Berry Blast.

§4 Claims policy
4.1 No ranking claims ('#1', 'number one') without an approved fact.
4.2 Never guarantee results.
4.3 Superlatives ('best', 'healthiest') need proof from the Fact Vault.
4.4 No health or medical claims (cures, heals, prevents). FSSAI advertising rules apply.
4.5 Every number in a post must match an approved fact.

facts.statement: Each NutriCrunch bar is 60 g and contains 20 g of protein.
Price is ₹99 per bar, or ₹549 for a pack of 6, from 1 Oct 2026.
There are 4 flavours: Choco Almond, Peanut Crunch, Coffee Kick and Berry Blast.
Bars are made in an FSSAI-licensed facility in Pune.
NutriCrunch bars contain no palm oil.
No added sugar. Each bar has 2 g of natural sugar from dates, so it is not sugar-free.
All flavours are vegetarian; Peanut Crunch and Berry Blast are vegan.
We ship across India in 3 to 5 working days.
Unopened packs can be returned within 7 days.
Rated 4.6 out of 5 from 2,300 reviews on our website.
NutriCrunch was founded in 2023 in Pune.
All bars contain nuts and are not suitable for people with nut allergies.
Coffee Kick contains 40 mg of caffeine per bar.
